worlds.generate.preview.timeout: 地图预览耗时过长，已被停止。请重试，或不预览直接生成世界。
worlds.generate.preview.oom: 游戏在生成地图预览时内存不足。请尝试较小的地图，或不预览直接生成世界。
worlds.generate.error.exchange_layout_ra: 此代码由 Factorio {version} 生成，其地图设置与 Factorio {game} 不兼容。它适用于 Factorio {from} 起至 {until} 之前（不含 {until}）的版本。请在上方选择此范围内的版本，或从 Factorio {game} 重新导出代码。
worlds.generate.version.other: 使用列表中没有的版本
worlds.generate.mode.settings_hint: 从预设开始，可修改任何设置，与游戏中的地图生成器相同。
worlds.generate.mode.exchange_hint: 使用他人从游戏中分享的地图设置。
worlds.generate.refilled: 下方的设置已按预设“{preset}”填写。请检查后再次选择“生成世界”。
worlds.generate.error.untested_preset: Foreman 无法为 Factorio {version} 写入此预设的地图设置，因此无法在该版本上修改这些设置。请重置为预设、从默认预设开始，或选择其他版本。
worlds.generate.preview.download_all: 下载所有已绘制的星球（ZIP）
worlds.generate.preview.updating: 正在按当前设置绘制地图预览…
worlds.generate.large.keys: Left and right arrows show the previous and next planet, plus and minus zoom, 0 fits the picture, and Escape closes. When zoomed in, drag the picture or use the arrow keys on it to move around.
worlds.generate.preview.pin: 图钉标记地图中心，即玩家的出生点。
worlds.generate.preview.size_hint: How much of the map, around its centre, the preview shows. Big sizes show their detail in the large view.
worlds.generate.error.preview_size: Choose one of the sizes in the list.
worlds.generate.territories.label: Show demolisher territories
worlds.generate.territories.hint: Finding them takes a few seconds more.
worlds.generate.territories.too_big_hint: Shown for preview sizes up to {size} × {size} tiles. Choose a smaller preview size to show them.
worlds.generate.territories.none: This picture has no demolisher territories.
worlds.generate.territories.no_vulcanus: Only Space Age worlds have demolisher territories, on Vulcanus.
worlds.generate.territories.too_big: Demolisher territories are shown for preview sizes up to {size} × {size} tiles. Choose a smaller preview size.
worlds.generate.territories.invalid: The settings have problems, so the demolisher territories were not found. Fix the problems the map preview lists.
worlds.generate.territories.busy: Another map preview is being made, so the demolisher territories were not found. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
worlds.generate.territories.timeout: Finding the demolisher territories took too long and was stopped. Try again, or choose a smaller preview size.
worlds.generate.territories.oom: The game ran out of memory finding the demolisher territories. Choose a smaller preview size.
worlds.generate.territories.failed: The game could not find the demolisher territories. The map preview and Generate still work. If it keeps failing, check Foreman's log.
worlds.generate.territories.request_fail: The request for the demolisher territories failed. Check that Foreman is reachable and that you are still signed in, then try again.
